messages:
marta: FYI KeelPoint cutover dry-run just finished. We're not seeing the VPC flow + CloudTrail audit bundles land in the customer's SIEM. Only partial request logs show up. Can infra/security take a look? @jared @owen :mag:

rachel: Is this happening for the full-cutover path or only for the cross-account forwarding path? Customer is sensitive because they need full retention for compliance and renewal check-in next month.

jared: Initial triage: their forwarder role assumes our redwood-forwarder role via sts:AssumeRole, then writes to S3 with SSE-KMS. When I replayed a put-object from their account we saw kms:Decrypt errors in CloudTrail. Snippet from CloudTrail: "errorCode":"AccessDenied","eventName":"GenerateDataKey".

owen: That screams KMS key policy scope. Many customer-managed keys lock down by aws:PrincipalOrgID or aws:SourceAccount and inadvertently block our cross-account execution chain. If it's policy scoping we need a minimal exception and audit stamp.

marta: Can you paste the offending policy lines if you find them? CS will need a one-paragraph explanation for the CSM to send. Also flag renewal risk in the note.

jared: Found it. Policy blocks all principals not in their org. They have a strict condition: "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalOrgID":"o-111aaa"}. That blocks our redwood account. Proposed minimal change: add an explicit allow for the exact forwarder ARN. Patching plan below.

```
# repro command
aws s3 cp empty.json s3://keelpoint-logs-test/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222233334444:key/def-456
# error
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation: Access Denied
```

Proposed policy snippet to add (will scope to kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt only):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodForwarderMinimal",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/log-forwarder"},
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource":"*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"222233334444","aws:SourceArn":"arn:aws:s3:::keelpoint-logs-*"}}
}
```

We'll test in a staging bucket first.

own: OK but change request: 1) fix Principal ARN typo (REWOOD_ACCOUNT -> REDWOOD_ACCOUNT) 2) restrict Resource to the key ARN 3) add an explicit auditing tag for the change request id. I can sign off after those changes.

jared: Good catch. I'll update and run staging. ETA ~45m for staging test + deployment request. If staging fails we fallback to temporary managed-key route while we escalate.

rachel: For the customer comms: short message template ready: "We observed encryption policy preventing log forwarding to your SIEM during our dry-run. We're applying a targeted update to permit Redwood's forwarder role to write encrypted logs; this is reversible and scoped; we'll validate end-to-end and share a status update within 2 hours. If you prefer we can enable a Redwood-managed key temporarily while we validate." I'll personalize after staging PASS. Also capturing renewal-watch: if logs are missing >24h that escalates to AM/renewals.

logs-bot: Ingest job queued: forwarder-prod -> keelpoint (job 4432). ETA 18m.

jared: Staging test PASS: PutObject + GenerateDataKey succeed, CloudTrail shows success. Pushed request to change-control with CSR-2026 tag.

own: Reviewing CSR-2026 now. I approve with the tightened resource ARN, principal fix, and a 2-hour ephemeral window if customer requests a managed-key fallback. I'll sign the prod patch.

marta: Great. Rachel please send the CS update now with expected prod patch window (2h) and include the runbook link: https://redwood-internal/onboard/keelpoint. Add renewal note to the CSM thread.

rachel: Sending now. Text: "Quick update: During pre-cutover tests we found your KMS policy restricted Redwood's forwarder role, preventing some audit logs from reaching your SIEM. We've applied a staged, minimal policy change in staging and will roll the prod patch during the next 2-hour maintenance window. If you'd rather we can temporarily switch to a Redwood-managed key for immediate coverage. We expect full validation within 2 hours and will post status updates. -KeelPoint Onboarding Team"

marta: Thanks. Owner:jared, blocker:resolved-in-staging, next: prod-roll (ETA 2h). Adding renewal-alert tag for AMs. :white_check_mark:
